sentences.text: Alistipes senegalensis is an anaerobic, Gram-negative, rod-shaped bacterium and a species of the genus Alistipes.
Its type strain was isolated from the faecal flora of an asymptomatic patient, and its genome of 4,017,609 base pairs contains 3,113 protein-coding genes.
A study in aged mice described it as an indole-producing commensal bacterium that was enriched by ginseng neutral polysaccharide.
In a community-based osteoarthritis study, participants with erosive hand osteoarthritis had a higher relative abundance of Alistipes senegalensis than controls.
